استؤذنا (form X)
# اُسْتُؤْذِنَا (ustuʔḏinā) /us.tuʔ.ði.naː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَأْذَنَ (istaʔḏana)
# اُسْتُؤْذِنَّا (ustuʔḏinnā) /us.tuʔ.ðin.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَأْذَنَ (istaʔḏana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
